country.match: Match each mystery to its country.

rows.label: Göbekli Tepe
rows.hook: is often called the world's oldest temple, predating Stonehenge by thousands of years

rows.label: Easter Island
rows.description: Polynesian island and special territory of Chile
rows.hook: is famous for hundreds of giant carved stone heads called moai

rows.label: Antikythera mechanism
rows.description: ancient analog computer designed to calculate astronomical positions
rows.hook: is a corroded bronze device from a shipwreck, often called the first computer

rows.label: Roanoke Colony
rows.description: former colony in present-day Dare County, North Carolina, US (1585–1590)
rows.hook: was an English settlement whose colonists vanished, leaving only "Croatoan" carved on a post

rows.label: The Great Sphinx
rows.hook: has a lion's body and a human head and guards a famous pyramid complex at Giza

rows.label: Flying Dutchman
rows.hook: is a spectral sailing vessel said to be doomed to roam the seas forever as an omen of bad luck

rows.label: Winchester Mystery House
rows.hook: was a sprawling mansion whose rifle-fortune heiress kept adding rooms to appease spirits

rows.label: Piri Reis map
rows.hook: is a chart drawn by an Ottoman admiral that some claim shows Antarctica

rows.label: Kryptos
rows.description: encrypted sculpture by American artist Jim Sanborn
rows.hook: is a sculpture at CIA headquarters carrying coded messages, one section still unsolved

rows.label: Nan Madol
rows.description: ruined city of Federated States of Micronesesia
rows.hook: is a city of artificial stone islets built on a reef, nicknamed the Venice of the Pacific

rows.label: The Hum
rows.hook: is a low droning noise that some people in certain towns claim to hear constantly

rows.label: Newgrange
rows.description: neolithic monument in County Meath, Ireland
rows.hook: is a passage tomb whose inner chamber is lit by the winter solstice sunrise

rows.label: Coral Castle
rows.description: visitor attraction in Leisure City, Florida, USA
rows.hook: was hand-built by one man from huge limestone blocks, rumored to be moved without machines

rows.label: Cottingley Fairies
rows.hook: were photos of two girls with winged sprites, praised by Sherlock Holmes's creator
